diff --git a/app/printing.py b/app/printing.py
index d532a34..3301b45 100644
--- a/app/printing.py
+++ b/app/printing.py
@@ -10,3 +10,19 @@ class Job:
 
 def total_pages(jobs: list[Job]) -> int:
     return sum(job.pages for job in jobs)
+
+
+def sheets_for(job: Job, double_sided: bool) -> int:
+    if double_sided:
+        return job.pages // 2
+    return job.pages
+
+
+def jobs_that_fit(jobs: list[Job], sheets_left: int, double_sided: bool) -> list[Job]:
+    jobs = sorted(jobs, key=lambda job: (job.pages, job.submitted), reverse=True)
+    chosen = []
+    while jobs and sheets_for(jobs[-1], double_sided) <= sheets_left:
+        job = jobs.pop()
+        sheets_left -= sheets_for(job, double_sided)
+        chosen.append(job)
+    return chosen
diff --git a/tests/test_printing.py b/tests/test_printing.py
index d3f9549..820002a 100644
--- a/tests/test_printing.py
+++ b/tests/test_printing.py
@@ -1,5 +1,20 @@
-from app.printing import Job, total_pages
+from app.printing import Job, jobs_that_fit, total_pages
 
 
 def test_total_pages_sums_each_job():
     assert total_pages([Job("memo", 3, 1), Job("report", 12, 2)]) == 15
+
+
+def test_one_sided_jobs_take_a_sheet_a_page():
+    jobs = [Job("report", 12, 1), Job("memo", 3, 2), Job("poster", 1, 3)]
+    assert jobs_that_fit(jobs, 5, double_sided=False) == [Job("poster", 1, 3), Job("memo", 3, 2)]
+
+
+def test_jobs_of_the_same_length_print_in_the_order_they_came():
+    jobs = [Job("b", 2, 2), Job("a", 2, 1), Job("c", 2, 3)]
+    assert jobs_that_fit(jobs, 4, double_sided=False) == [Job("a", 2, 1), Job("b", 2, 2)]
+
+
+def test_two_sided_jobs_take_a_sheet_for_two_pages():
+    jobs = [Job("report", 12, 1), Job("flyer", 2, 2)]
+    assert jobs_that_fit(jobs, 7, double_sided=True) == [Job("flyer", 2, 2), Job("report", 12, 1)]
